viewing_check: Confirm timber is cedar (red-brown, open grain, scent, underside of leaves and inside the apron) versus mahogany or other. Wind the table out and check the mechanism and winder handle are present and both leaves fit and match in colour. Check leaf count and overall extended length, castors, any splits, repairs or veneer on the top, and whether the legs are original and solid.
rate_note: All AUD, no conversion. Gowans prices are hammer, premium (about 19.8%) extra.
